purpose: Understand one missing supporting relationship in an invented workshop plan.

governance.review: The participant decides what the evidence means.
governance.correction: The source owner reviews the proposed declaration and reads it back.
governance.expression: A supporting relationship does not approve the workshop.

relations.meaning: The checklist supports consideration of the workshop without approving it.

questions.question: What supports consideration of the workshop?
questions.work: Read both sources and the declaration; decide whether this relation is useful.
